Launch: INFINITO v0.5 real-LLM confirmation of the memory-updates benchmark.

Approved by the maintainer on 2026-11-03. One run on the confirm2 partition
(seeds 5600000+, 5700000+, 5800000+, 5900000+ and 6000000+, never used
before). The v0.4 run used the confirm partition (Actions run 41550028202).

Systems: INFINITO v0.5 and the semantic RAG baseline that stores every
message and shows its top 8 in chronological order. Model gpt-5.6-luna with
reasoning "none", embeddings text-embedding-3-small, 320 context tokens for
both. Sets: e10b, e10d, personal, fresh, and fresh2, whose six templates were
written before any run and never embedded. 120 scenarios, 1,200 model calls.

What changed since v0.4: a retrieved memory is also kept when its similarity
to the query exceeds the median of the retrieved memories by 0.12 (and is at
least 0.25), calibrated offline on the dev partition only.

Decision rule, fixed before the run: INFINITO is confirmed if on every set it
is at most 2 scenarios below the RAG baseline and it abstains on at least 90%
of its negative controls. Whatever the outcome, it is reported as found.
